variants.name: Combo expenditure power charges
variants.charge_source_event: A Culmination-supported melee attack expends Combo; Ailith's Chimes grants Power Charges per Combo expended.

required_mechanics.requirement: A melee attack other than Flicker Strike supported by Culmination (adds ComboStacking; up to 10 Combo; Combo gained from other melee strikes; all Combo expended on use; 6000 ms decay delay). Seed: Whirling Assault
Ailith's Chimes on that attack (requires ComboStacking): 25% Surpassing chance per Combo expended to gain a Power Charge
Flicker Strike consumes the Power Charges: 2 additional teleporting strikes per Power Charge; no Power Charges gained while using it

seed_amplifiers.what: Overflowing Power, +2 maximum Power Charges (5 in the seed)
Martial Adept (additional Combo) and Martial Master (Combo from all Attack Hits), Martial Artist only
Perpetual Charge on Flicker Strike, 25% chance to not remove Charges but still count as consuming them

variants.benchmark_applicability: No kill or add event appears in the cited text, so flicker_sustained_v1 can supply this cycle, subject to gap-p09-t011-charge-cycle-rules.

variants.name: Shock consumption power charges
variants.charge_source_event: Siphoning Strike hits a Shocked target, consumes its Shock and grants a Power Charge.

required_mechanics.requirement: Siphoning Strike (Quarterstaff; base_consume_enemy_shock_on_hit; grants a Power Charge when it consumes Shock)
A separate source of Shock on the target: Siphoning Strike has never_shock
Flicker Strike consumes the Power Charges: 2 additional strikes per Power Charge

variants.benchmark_applicability: Needs a benchmark target that can be Shocked; unknown until gap-p09-t011-benchmark-target closes. No kill event in the cited text.

variants.name: Kill and cull power charges
variants.charge_source_event: Killing Palm kills or culls an enemy (cull below 10% life) and grants Power Charges by rarity: 1 normal or magic, 2 rare, 3 unique.

required_mechanics.requirement: Flicker Strike consumes the Power Charges: 2 additional strikes per Power Charge

variants.benchmark_applicability: Kill-dependent. D07 item 4 allows no adds or kill events in flicker_sustained_v1, so this source supplies no Power Charges there; only the clear and boss workloads supply kills.

variant_distinctness: The three variants differ in the event that grants the Power Charges Flicker Strike consumes: Combo expenditure, Shock consumption, enemy kill or cull. Each needs a different skill. Only the first has an export.
